name: Team PRs
description: Your team's open pull requests in a repo: how many, and each one's labels, CI and review.

project.label: Laki project
project.hint: the repo's, by name: for Review in Laki

actions.review: [ -n "$WIDGET_PROJECT" ] || { echo 'Set Laki project in Settings › Widgets' >&2; exit 1; }; "$LAKI_CLI" new "$WIDGET_PROJECT" --pr "$WIDGET_ARG" --prompt 'Review this pull request: read the diff, run what you can, and list what you would change and why.'
